purpose: Projection of existing BRAIN delivery, shared-memory, production-identity, evidence, cost/security and learning authorities into one mandatory activation chain for external producers; this is not a second delivery framework.

stageAuthorities.promotionAuthority: BG169 or platform-authorized equivalent registered by BRAIN-DELIVERY-v2
stageAuthorities.costEvidence: canonical cost fact linked to operation
stageAuthorities.learningWriteback: BG168 router → BG166 persistence → BG167 refresh/readback

notion.executionRole: knowledge/projection adapter; never production identity authority

supabase.executionRole: canonical persistence adapter with governed migration/readback

future.executionRole: unclassified producer stays non-production until registered and all stages pass
